newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NatMut NZ details strong fund returns in June year.
newsitem.headline: NatMut NZ details strong fund returns in June year.

text.p: National Mutual Funds Management said on Tuesday diversified superannuation funds under its discretionary management returned between 17.1 and 20.7 percent before tax in the year to June 30.
The funds returned between 8.5 and 10.5 percent before tax in the June quarter, which NMFM said more than offset their negative results of the previous quarter.
"We have to look back more than three years to find annual investment returns as strong as this," said NMFM chief investment officer Barry Lindsay.
The two best performers for the quarter were the New Zealand and international share sectors, which returned 15.2 and 16.3 percent before tax respectively.
Lindsay said a continuation of the strong gains could not be expected, and in NMFM's opinion, investment risks had now risen with the higher asset values.
Accordingly, NMFM had reduced its exposure to both New Zealand and international bonds as well as to international equities.
It had maintained its moderately above benchmark exposures to New Zealand equities and property, given the prospect of a stronger domestic economy over the next two years.
NMFM manages approximately NZ$3.4 billion of assets of which over $0.7 billion is on behalf of corporate superannuation funds.
